office: the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship
note: Zambia's Embassy in Washington (read 2026-11-03): the National Registration Card is issued to eligible Zambians of 16 and over, applied for and obtained only in Zambia, in person. That no fee is charged and the card is valid forever still stand on WikiProcedure's guide (a procedures wiki); the National Registration Act's text is only on a non-state host, which wasn't used. The time isn't stated.

sources.title: WikiProcedure, Zambia - Obtain National Identity Card
sources.said: Any Zambian citizen who doesn't have an NRC. Any child who's going to be 16 years of age. Fees Edit Application Fee : No fees are required for NRC. Validity Edit This document is valid forever.

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Zambia in Washington, Procedures for Acquiring National Documents
sources.said: NATIONAL REGISTRATION CARD (NRC) A National Registration Card is issued to eligible Zambian nationals aged 16 years and above. NRC can only be applied for and obtained in Zambia, in person.
